title: Founding of the Outpost
summary: How a salvage camp became a settlement.
content:
The first crews came for the floating ruins and stayed for the Gates.

## The Harbor Ring
The Harbor Ring was built in a single season, mostly from salvaged ruin-stone.

## The Ledger Hall
The Ledger Hall began as a tent where Quartermaster Varga counted crates. It now records every job posted on the board.
